title: C1
html: For a monotone pattern with three time points, state the complete-case missing value restriction — the unidentified conditional for a unit that dropped out after time j equals the corresponding conditional among units seen at all three times — and the neighbouring-case alternative. Show that both are particular choices of the unidentified factor in @eq-mis-pm-marginal, and that the MAR choice lies between them in a sense you should make precise.
